row.name: Microsoft Corporation Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)
checks.note: today would be breakout 4 of this move

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=14 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.19 tightness=0.65 base_volume_vs_leg=0.54 base_volume_vs_avg=0.69
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: volume did not exceed the prior session's

notes: extension: close 0.6% vs its 20-SMA, 3.8% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 3 of 3 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The chart shows MSFT is on its fourth breakout attempt from a 46-session, 45% move that is visibly extended and range-bound near 500–517 for the entire base period — the shaded box sits at the top of a long run with the 20-day and 50-day averages still well below, confirming trend age exhaustion. RE fails outright (today's 2.1% bar is smaller than the prior five bars) and VOL fails (volume 29% below the prior session), so the burst bar has neither range expansion nor volume confirmation. Y is a hard FAIL — this would be breakout four of the same move, which Bonde explicitly treats as the point where early buyers become sellers.
claude.key_risk: Three prior breakouts from this same base area have already absorbed the easy momentum; a fourth push at overhead supply near 517–525 with declining volume is a low-odds continuation.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open gaps above the entry ceiling or if the first 30 minutes show volume tracking below the prior session's pace with no ability to hold above 500.

row.summary: MSFT: +1.6% on 0.7× volume out of a base 6.1% deep. C 8.5, 5 of 6 criteria.
